## 🚀 Common Workflows

### Starting Phase 1
```
1. Read PACKAGE-SUMMARY.md
2. Read README.md
3. Set up environment
4. Start PHASE1-001
5. Reference main plan as needed
```

### Implementing a Task
```
1. Read task in phase1-rewrite-foundation.instructions.md
2. Check dependencies
3. Review implementation checklist
4. Write tests first
5. Implement feature
6. Update task status
7. Commit
```

### Understanding Iconsets
```
1. Read iconset-system-reference.md
2. Look at architecture-diagrams.md
3. Read current iconset code
4. Implement migration
```

### Avoiding Mistakes
```
1. Read archive2-analysis.md
2. When tempted to add complexity, re-read it
3. Keep Phase 1 simple
4. Reference "What Not to Do" section
```

## 📝 Updating This Documentation

### When to Update

- ✅ Tasks completed → Update status in main plan
- ✅ New decisions → Document in architecture-diagrams.md
- ✅ Issues found → Note in relevant document
- ✅ Better approaches discovered → Update main plan

### How to Update

1. Edit the relevant markdown file
2. Keep formatting consistent
3. Update this index if adding new files
4. Commit with clear message
